notes:
Cities you teleport are no longer counted twice. A city was recognised by where it sat on the map, so moving one left the old copy behind holding the resources it had at the time - an account with 480b food could read as 1.9t, and every total built from your cities was affected. RELAUNCH YOUR BOTS after updating so they send the new information.
Two accounts with the same name on different servers no longer share a Max Hero, cities, items or resource totals - everything matches on the account and its server now.
Live City Scripts is on the Tools page marked In Testing. It is unfinished and there so it can be tested; nothing it does can harm your accounts.
